description: Official operational dashboard for GitHub Deployment Bridge. Works with any Prometheus-compatible datasource. Set the Release variable to your Helm release name / fullnameOverride.

options.content:
**GitHub Deployment Bridge** — Flux → GitHub Deployments observer.

- Docs: [Grafana](https://deployment-bridge.eggl.dev/operations/grafana) · [Metrics](https://deployment-bridge.eggl.dev/configuration/metrics) · [Runbook](https://deployment-bridge.eggl.dev/operations/runbook)
- Set **Release** to your Helm release / `fullnameOverride` (default chart name: `github-deployment-bridge`).
- `deployment_failures_total` = Flux/app failure statuses (expected on bad deploys). `deployment_errors_total` = bridge-only faults (actionable).
- `github_api_requests_total` / latency series appear after the controller has issued GitHub API calls since process start.
